title: 第 74章 抓个笨贼

第 74章 抓个笨贼-《穿越60带着空间当保安》

那名队长实在不敢跟王野硬来，这货一看就踏马虎，这事儿要是闹大了，他们四个一好果子都吃不到。稳了稳情绪赶紧说：“小兄弟，这次是我们错了，您大人不记小人过，咱先把枪收起来，这要是走火了对谁都不好不是。”

王野只是想把他们镇住，可没想想过真弄死一两个，开玩笑呢，弄死警察就算是有理，就算是有他舅舅保他，他都得进去十年打底。

孙叔也赶紧劝道：“小野，不至于啊，把枪收起来。”

王野也就坡下驴把指着队长的枪放了下来但是仍厉色道：“既然你是他们的队长，你就该清楚咱是一条绳蚂蚱，刚踏马出四九城你们就整这出儿，是想找死呀？”

那队长赶紧从兜里拿出一包烟，抽出一根递给王野，又抽出一根递给孙叔说道：“小兄弟消消气，咱也不是故意找事儿，这不是看你们两个带的都是56半，这不是想着有你们值夜火力更强吗？”

王野没好气的说：“别整这些没用的，你们的责任就是押运物资，但是真要是碰上了，我们敢袖手旁观吗？”

王野这说的一点毛病都没有，这辆火车如果真碰到扒火车的，王野和孙叔理论上可以不管，可是这也就意味着他这辈子完了，光一句看着国家资源损失不闻不问就能治他的罪。

队长赶紧说：“小兄弟说的对，说的对。”

王野缓和了一下表情说道：“今天的事儿就到这里了，但是你们要是不服气咱可以练练，不论是拳脚还是枪法。”

那队长赶紧说：“兄弟，服气，绝对服气。就是有一点，咱能不能不把今天的事儿上报？”

王野无所谓的说道：“放心只要以后大家相安无事，我也不会把事情闹大，多一事不如少一事吗。”

那队长感恩戴德的说：“小兄弟，那就先谢谢你了，咱也算是不打不相识，我叫徐亮，以后要是买个车票什么的找我。”

王野也和徐亮客气了两句就和孙叔回包厢了。一进门孙叔就说：“小野，这次你怎么这么冲动呀，这可不是你的性格呀？”

王野笑呵呵的说：“孙叔，咱们在一个车厢住着，要么咱就委屈求全，大家相安无事，要么就一次性把他们搞怕。我可不是委屈自己的人，那就狠一点呗。”

孙叔觉得也不是没道理，但还是说道：“以后最好能不动枪还是不要动枪，真要走了火那麻烦就大了。”

王野笑呵呵的说：“放心吧孙叔，我没开保险。”

孙叔伸手点了点王野笑骂道：“你小子，真像科长说的粘上毛比猴子都精。”

王野这就不干了：“孙叔，我师父真这么说我啊？”

孙叔笑呵呵的说：“嗯～，现在差不多全科室都知道了。”

王野抓着头发彻底无语了，孙叔看王野的样子笑呵呵的说：“没事儿啊小野，多大点儿事儿呀。”

两人又闲聊了一会儿，孙叔就回自己的包厢了，王野继续开始看书。就这样一直到了十一点多，火车缓缓的停了。拉货的火车停车肯定是要加煤加水的，所以时间还是很长的。

理论上王野他们没什么事儿，可是也不能就在车上等着。孙叔叫着王野背上56半来到了站台上。徐亮看见两人，也上前打了个招呼，递了根儿烟。

就这样四位押运员，加上王野孙叔六人分散开不停的在火车周边巡逻。要不怎么说无巧不成书呢，就有那不长眼的人。王野到了车尾看见一个人偷偷摸摸的想看车里的货。

王野看得都着急了，这货是个傻子吧。居然想偷钢材，这东西现在对于老百姓来说用处真的不大，不当吃不当喝的，最主要的是想卖都卖不出去。

The captain really didn't dare to confront Wang Ye. This guy was careless at first sight. If this matter got serious, the four of them would not get any good results.After calming down, he quickly said: "Little brother, we were wrong this time. You don't remember the faults of villains. Let's put the gun away first. If it goes off, it won't be good for anyone."

Wang Ye just wanted to suppress them, but he never thought about actually killing one or two. Just kidding, even if it was justified to kill the police, even if his uncle protected him, he would have to go in for ten years to get the basics.

Uncle Sun also quickly advised: "Xiaoye, it's not serious, put the gun away."

Wang Ye just walked down the slope and put down the gun pointed at the captain, but still said sternly: "Since you are their captain, you should know that we are a grasshopper on a rope. You just stepped out of Sijiu City and started to mess with you. Are you looking for death?"

The captain quickly took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket, took out one and handed it to Wang Ye, and then took out another and handed it to Uncle Sun and said: "Little brother, calm down, we are not deliberately looking for trouble. Isn't it because you two are carrying 56 and a half? Isn't it because you have more firepower on night watch?"

Wang Ye said angrily: "Don't mess with these useless things. Your responsibility is to escort the supplies, but if we really encounter it, do we dare to stand by and watch?"

There is nothing wrong with what Wang Ye said. If this train really encounters a train robber, Wang Ye and Uncle Sun can theoretically ignore it, but this also means that his life is over. Just saying nothing about the loss of national resources can punish him.

The captain quickly said: "Little brother is right, you are right."

Wang Ye softened his expression and said: "That's all for today, but if you are not convinced, we can practice, whether it's fists, kicks or marksmanship."

The captain quickly said: "Brother, I am convinced, absolutely convinced. There is one thing, can we not report what happened today?"

Wang Ye said nonchalantly: "Don't worry, as long as everyone is in peace in the future, I won't make the matter a big deal. It's better to have less trouble than to have more trouble."

The captain said gratefully: "Little brother, thank you in advance. We don't know each other before. My name is Xu Liang. If you need to buy a ticket or something in the future, come to me."

Wang Ye also said a few polite words to Xu Liang and then returned to the box with Uncle Sun.As soon as he entered the door, Uncle Sun said: "Xiaoye, why are you so impulsive this time? This is not your character?"

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Uncle Sun, we live in the same carriage. Either we have to compromise and everyone is safe, or we scare them all at once. I'm not the one who wrongs myself, so I'll be more ruthless."

Uncle Sun felt that it was not unreasonable, but he still said: "In the future, it is best not to use the gun or not to use the gun. If it really goes wrong, there will be big trouble."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Don't worry, Uncle Sun, I don't have insurance."

Uncle Sun stretched out his hand and tapped it. Wang Ye smiled and scolded: "You boy, you are like the section chief said, and you are smarter than a monkey if you stick to the hair."

Wang Ye stopped now: "Uncle Sun, did my master really say that about me?"

Uncle Sun said with a smile: "Well~, almost the whole department knows about it now."

Wang Ye grabbed his hair and was completely speechless. Uncle Sun looked at Wang Ye and said with a smile: "It's okay, Xiaoye, what a big deal."

The two chatted for a while, then Uncle Sun returned to his box, and Wang Ye continued to read.It went like this until after eleven o'clock, when the train slowly stopped.When a train pulling goods stops, it must add coal and water, so it still takes a long time.

Theoretically, Wang Ye and the others have nothing to do, but they can't just wait in the car.Uncle Sun called Wang Ye to carry 56 and a half to the platform.When Xu Liang saw the two of them, he also stepped forward to say hello and handed them a cigarette.

In this way, the four escorts, plus Uncle Wang Ye and Sun, spread out and patrolled around the train.Otherwise, there are those people who don’t have a good eye.Wang Ye arrived at the back of the car and saw a man sneaking around to see the goods in the car.

Wang Ye looked anxious, this guy must be a fool.He actually wants to steal steel. This thing is really not of much use to the people now. It is not suitable for eating or drinking. The most important thing is that it cannot be sold even if it wants to be sold.
